message.content:
**神舟八号（Shenzhou‑8）** 是中国空间站计划中的一次无人试验飞行，主要用于验证与天宫一号（Tiangong‑1）的对接技术。它于 2008 年 9 月 29 日发射，成功完成了对接任务，但并未携带任何宇航员。

> **结论**：神舟八号没有宇航员，属于无人试验飞行。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "神舟八号的宇航员是谁" meaning "Who were the astronauts of Shenzhou 8?" They want the names of the crew of Shenzhou 8. We need to answer. According to known info: Shenzhou 8 was a Chinese spaceflight in 2008, part of the Shenzhou program. It was an unmanned test flight? Wait, Shenzhou 8 was the first test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft with a docking test with Tiangong-1. It was unmanned? Actually Shenzhou 8 was an unmanned test flight. It was launched on 29 September 2008. It docked with Tiangong-1. It had no crew. So the answer: It was unmanned, no astronauts. But maybe the user expects "Shenzhou 8 had no crew; it was an unmanned test flight." Provide that. Also mention that Shenzhou 9 had crew. So answer accordingly.
